text: Every day, technology moves a little faster.
And every day, someone gets left a little further behind.
It starts with a message she doesn't understand.
Is it real? What do I press? Who do I ask?
A patient helper for the moments tech gets confusing.
Take a photo. See where to tap.
Companion circles the exact button, then waits while you try it.
A calm second opinion. Before you tap a link or reply, it explains what looks wrong, in plain words.
A little less help every time. Step by step at first, then a hint, then just a nudge. Until it's yours.
Stuck? Ask family, your way. A clear note for your daughter, shared only when you say yes.
Print a lesson card for the fridge.
Growing technology is not a reason to leave others behind.
